messages:
joy_cs: Heads-up 3 we got three onboarding notes today about quota previews. Customers expect a per-customer quota estimator in the Console (so they can forecast spend before scaling). Two are flagged renewal-risk because they hit unexpected throttles. Need a quick capture flow to funnel to product.

noah_onboard: Seen it on calls too 3 people want a soft-limit preview and a way to request temporary burst increases during ramp. Right now its buried in docs. A one-click Slack modal for CSMs to file this would be great.

matt_product: Good signal. Proposed minimal fields: org + contact, account age, symptom (one line), expected behaviour (what they wanted the UI to show), severity suggestion, sample route/deployment, whether they experienced a throttle, and attachments. If phrasing clusters we push a quick UI iteration.

ester_eng: For diagnostics include deployment (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), recent autoscale events (if account id provided we can attach a 24h summary), and whether they used burst capacity. I can add a webhook that creates a tracker issue and optionally attaches the diagnostic bundle.

joy_cs: Draft modal text below (single modal):
```
Problem: one-line summary
Customer: org + contact
Account age (days):
Where seen: console / API / docs / support
Observed: (short bullets)
Expected: (short bullets)
Experienced throttle? yes / no
Route or pool: (optional)
Deployment: Hosted / Dedicated / Private
Attach: screenshot / link
Suggested priority: low / med / high
```

noah_onboard: That works. I'll push the first two captures from today's calls through once the shortcut exists. Tag them with "onboard-quota" in tracker.

capture_bot: New capture created: QP-2026-411 "Console lacks per-customer quota preview" submitted by noah_onboard. Link: https://tracker.internal/QP-2026-411

matt_product: I'll add a triage slot tomorrow. If we see 4+ captures referencing "soft-limit preview" in 10 days we queue a UX spike.

ester_eng: Building Slack shortcut + webhook tonight. @joy_cs please DM a test account id so I can validate the autoscale summary attach.

joy_cs: Sent DM with test id. Appreciate the quick turn 3 aiming to have shortcut live by EOD so enablement can use it in tomorrow's ramp calls.
